messages:
Mia: Heads up — I'm opening a tiny PR to extract the SDK snippets from the Optimize toolkit page into a shared examples folder. Goal is simpler link rotation and fewer copy/paste fixes later.

Dennis: sounds good. can you add the JS + Go + Python variants? we still have a handful of downstream docs referencing the old inline bits. :+1:

Mia: Yep. plan is js/python first, then go in a follow-up. Also will add a short migration blurb for qprofiles.

Sarah: Quick ask — can those snippets include the `batching` and `kv_prefetch` config shown in the migration guide? customers keep missing the `prefetch_size` recommendation.

Mia: Will do. thinking of a minimal example:```json
{
  "model": "rwkv-13b",
  "batching": { "max_batch_tokens": 2048 },
  "kv_prefetch": { "prefetch_size": 64 }
}
```Keep it tiny.

Ryan: For the qprofile bit, recommend we show `quantize: int8` + a one-line note about perf/quality tradeoff. otherwise folks will blindly use 4-bit profiles.

Dennis: Agreed. also add a note to link back to the Optimize console heuristics page — i.e. where the default qprofiles live. Saves product questions.

Lena: I can run a quick lint pass after you push. FYI there's a broken anchor in the current migration guide (the `kv-prefetch` header). I filed a tiny fix in #docs-snag earlier.

docs-bot: PR opened by Mia in docs/examples — 1761112223. Ready for review. :rocket:
